arxiv-2111-12927.title: Rethinking Generic Camera Models for Deep Single Image Camera Calibration to Recover Rotation and Fisheye Distortion
arxiv-2111-12927.creator: Nobuhiko Wakai, Satoshi Sato, Yasunori Ishii, Takayoshi Yamashita
arxiv-2111-12927.description: Abstract Although recent learning-based calibration methods can predict extrinsic and intrinsic camera parameters from a single image, the accuracy of these methods is degraded in fisheye images. This degradation is caused by mismatching between the actual projection and expected projection. To address this problem, we propose a generic camera model that has the potential to address various types of distortion.

arxiv-2208-09614.title: An ensemble meta-estimator to predict source code testability Journal: Applied Soft Computing
arxiv-2208-09614.creator: Morteza Zakeri-Nasrabadi, Saeed Parsa
arxiv-2208-09614.description: Abstract Unlike most other software quality attributes, testability cannot be evaluated solely based on the characteristics of the source code. The effectiveness of the test suite and the budget assigned to the test highly impact the testability of the code under test.

arxiv-2311-12936.title: Slowly moving black holes in khrono-metric model
arxiv-2311-12936.creator: A. Kovachik, S. Sibiryakov
arxiv-2311-12936.description: Abstract We search for solutions describing slowly moving non-rotating black holes in the khrono-metric model, a modified gravity theory with preferred time (khronon) which arises at low energies from the non-projectable Hořava gravity. We work in the decoupling limit when the back-reaction of the khronon on the metric is small and can be treated perturbatively.

arxiv-2508-11915.title: CORE: Measuring Multi-Agent LLM Interaction Quality under Game-Theoretic Pressures
arxiv-2508-11915.creator: Punya Syon Pandey, Yongjin Yang, Jiarui Liu, Zhijing Jin
arxiv-2508-11915.description: Abstract Game-theoretic interactions between agents with Large Language Models (LLMs) have revealed many emergent capabilities, yet the linguistic diversity of these interactions has not been sufficiently quantified. In this paper, we present the Conversational Robustness Evaluation Score: CORE, a metric to quantify the effectiveness of language use within multi-agent systems across different game-theoretic interactions.

arxiv-2510-01715.title: PyramidStyler: Transformer-Based Neural Style Transfer with Pyramidal Positional Encoding and Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2510-01715.creator: Raahul Krishna Durairaju, Dr. K. Saruladha
arxiv-2510-01715.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Raahul Krishna Durairaju, Dr. K. Saruladha. Neural Style Transfer (NST) has evolved from Gatys et al.’s (2015) CNN-based algorithm, enabling AI-driven artistic image synthesis. However, existing CNN and transformer-based models struggle to scale efficiently to complex styles and high-resolution inputs. We introduce PyramidStyler, a transformer framework with Pyramidal Positional Encoding (PPE): a hierarchical, multi-scale encoding that captures both local details and global context while reducing computational load. We further incorporate reinforcement learning to dynamically optimize stylization, accelerating convergence.

arxiv-2602-02680.title: FlexRank: Nested Low-Rank Knowledge Decomposition for Adaptive Model Deployment
arxiv-2602-02680.creator: Riccardo Zaccone, Stefanos Laskaridis, Marco Ciccone, Samuel Horváth
arxiv-2602-02680.description: Abstract The growing scale of deep neural networks, encompassing large language models (LLMs) and vision transformers (ViTs), has made training from scratch prohibitively expensive and deployment increasingly costly. These models are often used as computational monoliths with fixed cost, a rigidity that fails to leverage overparametrized architectures and largely hinders adaptive deployment across different cost budgets.

pmc-10502320.title: Comparisons of the effects of silk elastin and collagen sponges on wound healing in murine models
pmc-10502320.creator: Eiichi Sawaragi, Hiroki Yamanaka, Yuanjiaozi Li, Tomo Unzai, Shingo Kawabata, Takashi Nakano, Yasuhiro Katayama, Michiharu Sakamoto, Yasuhiko Tabata, Naoki Morimoto
pmc-10502320.description: IntroductionsSilk elastin, a recombinant protein with repeats of elastin and silk fibroin, possesses a self-gelling ability and is a potential wound dressing material. The aim of this study is to elucidate the mechanism of the wound healing-promoting effect of silk elastin by comparing its in vivo behavior in a mouse wound model with that of a collagen sponge.

pmc-10569099.title: Aptamer Conformational Dynamics Modulate Neurotransmitter Sensing in Nanopores
pmc-10569099.creator: Annina Stuber, Ali Douaki, Julian Hengsteler, Denis Buckingham, Dmitry Momotenko, Denis Garoli, Nako Nakatsuka
pmc-10569099.description: Aptamers that undergo conformational changes upon small-molecule recognition have been shown to gate the ionic flux through nanopores by rearranging the charge density within the aptamer-occluded orifice. However, mechanistic insight into such systems where biomolecular interactions are confined in nanoscale spaces is limited.

pmc-10601175.creator: Vedran Velagic, Giacomo Mugnai, Ivan Prepolec, Vedran Pasara, Anica Milinković, Andrija Nekić, Jakov Emanuel Bogdanic, Jurica Putric Posavec, Davor Puljević, Carlo de Asmundis, Gian-Battista Chierchia, Davor Milicic
pmc-10601175.description: PurposeIntra-cardiac echocardiography (ICE) has become an important tool for catheter ablation. Adoption of ICE imaging is still limited because of its prohibitively high cost. Our aim was to study the safety and feasibility of ICE catheters reprocessing and its environmental and financial impact.

pmc-10650007.title: Applying the Adjusted Chinese Dietary Balance Index-16 to Assess the Dietary Quality of Chinese Postpartum Lactating Mothers
pmc-10650007.creator: Junyue Jiang, Jiating Huang, Yanyan Su, Yu Wang
pmc-10650007.description: A balanced diet is considered necessary in maternal recovery and neonatal development; however, the dietary quality of lactating mothers in China has not been systematically evaluated in different regions and stages of lactation. In addition, the release of the Chinese Dietary Guidelines in 2022 implies that the dietary index method needs to be adjusted accordingly.

pmc-11527816.title: Prognostic role of lipoprotein(a) in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease risk from a perspective on current risk stratification
pmc-11527816.creator: Sha Li, Hui‐Hui Liu, Yan Zhang, Meng Zhang, Hui‐Wen Zhang, Cheng‐Gang Zhu, Na‐Qiong Wu, Rui‐Xia Xu, Qian Dong, Jie Qian, Ke‐Fei Dou, Yuan‐Lin Guo, Jian‐Jun Li
pmc-11527816.description: Lipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)] is an emerging predictor for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) but the association from a perspective on current risk stratification was unknown. A cohort of 9944 Chinese patients with ASCVD was recruited and refined into very‐high‐risk (VHR) and non‐VHR subgroups according to current guideline.

pmc-12647665.title: Overburden movement laws in thin bedrock workfaces under thick backfilled loose bodies
pmc-12647665.creator: Wenxiang Zheng, Chao Wei, Shuai Guo, Zhipeng Zhuang, Changhui Shi
pmc-12647665.description: A detailed investigation was conducted on the geological conditions of thin bedrock workfaces under thick backfilled loose bodies in the first panel of the 22-upper coal seam at Shigetai Coal Mine. Utilizing both physical similarity modeling and numerical simulation techniques, the study comprehensively examined the overburden movement patterns and failure characteristics under these conditions.

pmc-12702423.title: Challenges of regenerative medicine: New strategies from traditional Chinese medicine
pmc-12702423.creator: Jiuhong Kang
pmc-12702423.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). s, or viral reprogramming face fundamental limitations. These include donor scarcity, high toxicity, and genetic mutation risks, which preclude definitive cures. In contrast, natural products derived from traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) leverage their multi-targeted, low-toxicity microenvironment-modulating properties. These compounds not only establish a foundation for human applications through high safety margins and millennia-spanning clinical documentation, but also enable metabolic reprogramming, epigenetic remodeling, and coordinated signaling network modulation.

pmc-12962254.title: When Do Generics Feel Justifiable? A Registered Report Bridging Key Theories
pmc-12962254.creator: Felix Hermans, Walter Schaeken, Susanne Bruckmüller, Vera Hoorens
pmc-12962254.description: Bare plural generics (‘generics’ for short) attribute a feature to members of a category without specifying how many actually possess the feature (e.g., ‘Belgians love fries’). Generics are often used to perpetuate stereotypes and misinformation, yet researchers from many different fields disagree about how people decide what justifies a generic.

Objectives Lead and mercury are recognised as critical determinants of population health, especially for children and pregnant women. Few UK cohorts have measured lead or mercury in pregnant women since 1990. pmc-13541599.title: Astragalus membranaceus therapy in patients with spinocerebellar ataxia type 3
pmc-13541599.creator: Chungmin Chiu, Wenling Cheng, Tatsung Lin, Huiju Chang, Minhui Tseng, Yujun Chang, Shihli Su, Chiaju Lee, Henhong Chang, Chinsan Liu
pmc-13541599.description: Background and aimSpinocerebellar ataxia type 3 (SCA3) is the most common form of hereditary cerebellar ataxia. The insulin/insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF1) system (IIS) has been proposed as a potential target for disease-modifying therapy. Astragalus membranaceus (AM) may modulate the IIS pathway and reduce neurodegeneration, as indicated by plasma neurofilament light chain (NfL), a biomarker of disease progression.
